item.title: Intranet Inspiration
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
Just purchased Jakob Nielsen’s new screenshot-packed “10 Best Intranets of 2009” report, which I plan to use as inspiration in my company.

It might be of value to other Capgemini employees so I purchased the “site license to make copies within your organization and place on your own intranet”. Capgemini colleagues are free to contact me and I’ll provide a link to the report.

UPDATE: i have added the report here at our internal Capgemini wiki: http://wiki.capgemini.com/index.php/UsabilityResources
